content: {"reasoning":"CO-97 identifies this service as bundled into another paid service, so the balance is a contractual adjustment rather than deductible or coinsurance owed by the patient. The case provides no evidence of a coding error or separately payable service to support rework or an appeal; missing authorization is irrelevant because authorization is not required. Secondary coverage alone does not establish an obligation to pay this bundled charge, so the balance should be written off.","action":"write_off"}
